memory_update.text: SAIL should remain the reference identity-governance anchor for this node, especially for AI-agent and machine-identity governance, but must be tested for product-level ARR contribution.
VRNS is a strong underfollowed candidate for AI data-security posture and AI TRiSM convergence; key survival evidence is SaaS ARR acceleration and AllTrue.ai integration traction.
AVPT is an underappreciated AI-readiness and agent-governance beneficiary within SaaS data protection, particularly around Microsoft 365/Copilot and multi-SaaS governance.

node: Cloud security, identity, observability, data governance, AI compliance, and automation software
summary: Layer 1B expands the cloud-security and AI-control-plane software node with one reference pure-play identity anchor and three underfollowed small/mid-cap discovery candidates. The working chokepoint is not generic AI software, but the control layer required when AI agents, copilots, machine identities, SaaS data sprawl, incident automation, and regulated workflows proliferate. Candidates were prioritized for direct exposure to identity governance, AI data-security posture, agent governance, and AIOps/incident orchestration rather than broad AI branding. This is research support only and not a buy/sell recommendation.
